verdict.rationale: Exa's docs claim a 'Get Code' feature that generates a 'complete, tested integration snippet' in under a minute (exa-docs-11), and the JS SDK provides runnable code examples (exa-gh-1-5), but there's no evidence of a true interactive API reference (OpenAPI/Swagger endpoints all 404'd per exa-probe-3), and a hands-on reviewer found the generated cURL example in 'Get Code' to be 'demonstrably wrong' (exa-comm-4), directly contradicting the 'tested' claim. missing for 10: a genuine try-it-out API console, working/tested generated snippets, independent confirmation the code examples run correctly.
